subject.title: ci(mantis): add web UI chat proof lane

question: Should this new Mantis web UI chat workflow land before default-registered workflow dispatch, artifact upload, and qa-live-shared publishing have been proven?
rationale: The contributor proof demonstrates the candidate browser test path, but it cannot fully prove the trusted GitHub Actions registration and secret-backed publishing boundary added by this PR.

options.title: Require trusted proof first
options.body: Use a maintainer-owned or default-registered workflow run to prove candidate execution, artifact upload, and Mantis PR evidence publishing before merge.

options.title: Accept publish-boundary risk
options.body: Merge based on code review, CI, and local-container artifacts while explicitly owning any dispatch, artifact, or secret-backed publish failure found after merge.

options.title: Adopt a maintainer branch
options.body: Move the branch to a maintainer-owned path if the fork head cannot produce the required trusted proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Require trusted proof first
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer-owned or default-registered workflow run to prove candidate execution, artifact upload, and Mantis PR evidence publishing before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history on the Mantis dispatcher, reusable publisher, and docs surfaces involved in the proof decision.
